summary: The ErrorOccurred page is part of the HSPnet web application. It displays error messages when a user encounters an error on the site. The page supports both English and French locales, dynamically customizing content based on the user's language preference. It retrieves configuration settings for email addresses and displays specific error messages.
purpose: To display error messages and provide support information to users who encounter errors on the HSPnet platform.

fields.name: HeaderEN
fields.description: Panel control for displaying the header in English.

fields.name: HeaderFR
fields.description: Panel control for displaying the header in French.

fields.name: uxErrorMessage
fields.description: Label control for displaying error messages.

workflows.name: Display Error Page
steps: The page checks the 'Locale' query parameter to determine the user's language preference.
The appropriate header (English or French) is displayed based on the locale.
The page retrieves the configured error email address from the web.config file.
The page checks if a 'HttpRequestValidationException' has occurred.
A specific error message is displayed depending on the presence of 'HttpRequestValidationException'.

business_rules: Error email address is retrieved from configuration settings (web.config) and can be customized.
Locale defaults to 'en-US' if not provided or invalid.
validations: If 'HttpRequestValidationException' is present in the query string, a specific validation exception message is shown.
conditions: The visibility of HeaderEN and HeaderFR panels depends on the 'Locale' value in the query string.
system_behavior: The system dynamically changes the UI culture based on the user's locale preference.
dependencies: Configuration settings for email and database name.
